job.question: What are the evaluation criteria and their weights used in Level IV of the LACERS 2025 actuarial consulting services RFP?
job.expected_facts: Professionalism 15; Proposed Scope of Services Description and Methodology 30; Qualifications, Experience, and Accomplishments 35; Value of Cost 20; Total 100.
job.acceptance: Professionalism15, proposed scope/method30, qualifications/experience35, value/cost20. Points or percentages accepted because weights total100.

reviews.reason: The document is KCERA’s 2024 actuarial audit services RFP, not LACERS’s 2025 actuarial consulting services RFP. Its evaluation criteria and weights differ, and it does not identify a Level IV evaluation.
quotes: Kern County Employees’ Retirement Association Request for Proposal ACTUARIAL AUDIT SERVICES March 29, 2024
The weighted factors listed below will be considered by KCERA when evaluating the firms’ submittals.
Firm’s Experience and Capabilities 30% Quality of Assigned Professional Personnel 25% Communication (Written and Verbal) 25% Cost 20%
